name: Flat lichen-covered slab 009
prompt: a single natural fieldstone boulder resting on the ground, rounded and weathered, with subtle cracks, pits and patches of moss, flat lichen-covered slab, completely unlit, no glow, no light sources, no self-emission

placement.note: ONE SCENERY PIXEL IS ONE PLAYER PIXEL. world_px_height IS the art's own alpha bbox height, so scenery is placed into the world at 1:1 exactly as the avatar is (setScale(1)) and the two share one pixel grid. The CAMERA still zooms the whole scene — that is uniform and correct; what must never happen is scenery being resampled on its own, against the player. world_height_m is what the art reads as beside a 87px character; declared_height_m is what it was once declared to be, and a gap between them means the ART is the wrong size.

motion.description: This is the same picture in every frame. ONLY the glowing cracks across the stone brighten a little and return. It is lit and clearly visible in every single frame, including the first. It only ever gets SLIGHTLY brighter: never white, never washed out, and it keeps its own colour at every single moment. It is at its brightest in the middle and back to exactly its first-frame brightness and colour at the end, never dimmer at the end than at the start. Everything else in the picture is copied from the first frame exactly, pixel for pixel, unchanged in shape, size, position and colour. No outline anywhere is redrawn. The last frame matches the first frame exactly, so the loop joins.

light.reference: the spawn bonfire is 1.0 (radius 7); strength 0 is no light
